# sigma_allowed_ip (Resource)

An entry in the org's IP allowlist (Sigma beta API). One TF resource manages one entry; the underlying API is batch-only, so Create sends a one-element batchCreate and Destroy sends a one-element batchDelete.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) IPv4 / IPv6 address or CIDR range.
- `scope` (String) One of `public-api`, `ui`, or `both` — which surface the allowlist entry applies to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the entry.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Sigma-assigned `ipAllowlistEntryId`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_allowed_ip.example '<ip_allowlist_entry_id>'
```
